mapper.insert: INSERT INTO LOAN_REPAYMENT_HISTORY (APPLICATION_ID, PAYMENT_SEQ, REPAYMENT_TYPE, TOTAL_PAYMENT, PRINCIPAL_AMOUNT, INTEREST_AMOUNT, REMAINING_BALANCE, PAID_AT) VALUES (#{applicationId}, #{paymentSeq}, #{repaymentType}, #{totalPayment}, #{principalAmount}, #{interestAmount}, #{remainingBalance}, #{paidAt})
mapper.select: SELECT HISTORY_ID, APPLICATION_ID, PAYMENT_SEQ, REPAYMENT_TYPE, TOTAL_PAYMENT, PRINCIPAL_AMOUNT, INTEREST_AMOUNT, REMAINING_BALANCE, PAID_AT FROM LOAN_REPAYMENT_HISTORY WHERE APPLICATION_ID = #{applicationId} ORDER BY PAYMENT_SEQ ASC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM LOAN_REPAYMENT_HISTORY WHERE APPLICATION_ID = #{applicationId}
